name: Somchai Chaiyawat
bio:
Somchai Chaiyawat's journey into motorsport started with a fascination for mechanics, nurtured in his father's small motorcycle repair shop in Bangkok. He earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Chulalongkorn University, followed by advanced studies in vehicle dynamics in the UK. He began his career in touring cars, quickly gaining a reputation for meticulous data analysis and problem-solving. His ability to translate complex telemetry data into actionable insights for drivers made him a sought-after asset.

Somchai joined Iron Lynx five years ago, where he has become integral to the team's success. He is known for his pragmatic approach to performance engineering, focusing on incremental improvements and reliability. While not a flashy innovator, his dedication to optimization and his ability to extract maximum performance from existing resources are invaluable. He's respected for his unflappable demeanor under pressure, and his deep understanding of vehicle dynamics makes him a vital link between the drivers and the engineering team.

Somchai’s loyalty to Iron Lynx is unwavering, and he prioritizes the team’s success above all else. His meticulous nature, though sometimes leading to delays as he chases perfection, ensures the car is always performing at its peak.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a wiry build, often seen wearing his team-issued polo shirt and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn-out notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Insists on drinking jasmine tea at precisely 3:00 PM every day.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically against his teeth when deep in thought.
